title: Modi-Macron: "For the past three decades, France has been one of India's strategic partners"
summary: In a post on X, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi said his visit to France will focus on strengthening economic and cultural ties, starting in Nice, where he will attend the ‘Bharat Innovates’ programme with French President Emmanuel Macron. We discuss the visit with Aparna Pande, Director of the India and South Asia Initiative at the Hudson Institute.
